_readme: Feeds the daily job reads. enabled=false sources are skipped. fullTextAllowed controls whether the job may read the article body (from the feed or the page) to extract facts; leave it false until you've reviewed that publisher's terms. With it false, the job only uses the headline and the feed's short summary, and skips stories it can't support.
